items.title: 1.1 Physical quantities (tabi'i miqdarein) aur un ke units (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.1 with the chapter's opening paragraphs (PDF 4-5).

blocks.text: Physics science ki sab se fundamental (sab se buniyadi) branch (shakh) hai. Yeh woh basic principles (buniyadi usool) aur laws (qanoon) deti hai jin se science ki doosri branches, jaise astronomy, chemistry, geology, biology aur health sciences, ke raaz (mysteries) samajh aate hain. Physics ke tools (auzaar), techniques aur products ne hamare khwabon ko haqeeqat bana diya hai. Hamari zindagi mein jo comfort (aaram) aur sahooliyat aayi hai woh rozmarra zindagi mein science, technology aur engineering ka phal hai.

Information technology ne insaan ka outlook (soch ka andaaz) bilkul badal diya hai. Communication (rabta) ke tez zariyon ne poori duniya ke logon ko itna qareeb kar diya hai ke saari duniya ek global village (poori duniya ek gaaon jaisi) ban gayi hai.
Computer chips silicon se bante hain, aur silicon ret (sand) se milta hai. Yeh hum par hai ke ret se ret ka qila banayein ya computer.
blocks.title: Think over! (Is par sochiye!)

blocks.text: Physics ek experimental (tajurbe par based) science hai, aur scientific method is baat par zor deta hai ke napi ja sakne wali physical quantities ki accurate (bilkul sahi) measurement (naap) ki jaye. Yeh chapter napne ki techniques aur readings record karne ki skills (maharat) samjhane par zor deta hai.

Physics ki foundation (buniyad) physical quantities par hai; physics ke laws inhi quantities mein likhe jate hain. Is liye in quantities ko accurately (sahi sahi) napna zaroori hai. Examples: mass, length, time, velocity, force, density, temperature, electric current aur bohat si doosri.

Physical quantities aam taur par do qismon mein banti hain: base quantities aur derived quantities. Derived quantities woh hain jo base quantities par depend karti hain (un se banti hain), maslan velocity, acceleration, force waghaira. Base quantities kisi doosri physical quantity ke zariye define nahi hotin. Yeh independent (kisi par depend na karne wali) quantities hain jin ke zariye baqi sab physical quantities define ki ja sakti hain. Aam examples: length, mass aur time.

Kisi base quantity ki measurement mein do steps hain: pehla, ek standard (napne ka tay shuda paimana) chunna; doosra, napi jane wali quantity ko us standard se milane ka tareeqa tay karna, taake us quantity ki measurement ek number aur ek unit ki shakal mein mil jaye.
Measurements reliable (jin par bharosa ho) aur accurate (sahi) honi chahiye taake unhen aasani se aur sahi tarah istemal kiya ja sake.

blocks.prompt: Kya density base quantity hai ya derived, aur base quantity napne mein kaun se do steps hain?
blocks.explanation: Density derived quantity hai: density = mass / volume, aur volume khud length se banta hai. Base quantity napne ke do steps: (1) ek standard chunna, (2) napi jane wali quantity ko us standard se milane ka tareeqa tay karna, jis se ek number aur ek unit milta hai.

items: Physics experimental science hai; us ke laws physical quantities mein likhe jate hain, is liye inhen accurately napna zaroori hai.
Base quantities (length, mass, time) independent hain; derived quantities (velocity, acceleration, force) un par depend karti hain.
Base quantity ki measurement: standard chunein, phir compare karne ka tareeqa tay karein; result = number + unit.
